name: Admin Send Proposal Email (Sent+)
description: Admin sends one proposal follow-up email from the Correos tab once the proposal is sent or beyond, addressed to multiple Para recipients and optional visible CC recipients through the hybrid client/manual picker (10 unique addresses total). Each delivery writes one ProposalChangeLog activity, updates last_activity_at and appears once in grouped history while retaining one status row per address. The shared composer also supports Markdown sections, preview and attachments. Endpoints: POST /api/proposals/:id/proposal-email/send/, GET defaults/history and POST markdown-attachment.
